package handler

import (
	db "example.com/survival-extraction-practice/db"
	matchentity "example.com/survival-extraction-practice/game/entities/survival_raid"
	survival "example.com/survival-extraction-practice/game/survival"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"time"
)

type ISurvivalRaidEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.SurvivalRaidDao
	TimerComp() *matchentity.TimerComponent
}
type ISurvivalPlayerEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.PlayerDao
}

// 创建内存实体不代表已持久化；玩家建档必须经过一次正式事务。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerSurvivalPlayerInit(p ISurvivalPlayerEntity) error {
	if !p.Dao().GetInitialized() {
		p.Dao().SetGold(100)
		p.Dao().SetInitialized(true)
	}
	return nil
}

// 成局名单、配置、时间来自服务端。相同 Room ID 不允许改名单或重置探险。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerSurvivalInit(m ISurvivalRaidEntity, ids [survival.Seats]int64, r survival.Rules, now int64) (survival.View, error) {
	if m.Dao().GetState() != "" {
		s, e := survival.Decode(m.Dao().GetState())
		if e != nil {
			return survival.View{}, e
		}
		for i, id := range ids {
			if s.Seats[i].PlayerID != id {
				return survival.View{}, survival.ErrRule
			}
		}
		return s.View(ids[0])
	}
	s, e := survival.New(ids, r, now)
	if e != nil {
		return survival.View{}, e
	}
	if e = saveSurvival(m, s); e != nil {
		return survival.View{}, e
	}
	return s.View(ids[0])
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerSurvivalCommand(m ISurvivalRaidEntity, playerID int64, c survival.Command, now int64) (survival.Receipt, error) {
	s, e := survival.Decode(m.Dao().GetState())
	if e != nil {
		return survival.Receipt{}, e
	}
	r, changed, e := s.Apply(playerID, c, now)
	if e != nil {
		return r, e
	}
	if changed {
		e = saveSurvival(m, s)
	}
	return r, e
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerSurvivalView(m ISurvivalRaidEntity, playerID int64) (survival.View, error) {
	s, e := survival.Decode(m.Dao().GetState())
	if e != nil {
		return survival.View{}, e
	}
	return s.View(playerID)
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerSurvivalConnect(m ISurvivalRaidEntity, playerID int64, ticket uint64, connected bool) error {
	s, e := survival.Decode(m.Dao().GetState())
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if e = s.Connect(playerID, ticket, connected); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	m.Dao().SetState(s.Encode())
	return nil
}

// 当前鉴权连接可查旧 Epoch 回执，但不能把旧命令换成新 Seq 重做。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerSurvivalReceipt(m ISurvivalRaidEntity, playerID int64, epoch, seq uint64) (survival.Receipt, error) {
	s, e := survival.Decode(m.Dao().GetState())
	if e != nil {
		return survival.Receipt{}, e
	}
	i := s.Index(playerID)
	if i < 0 || s.Seats[i].Epoch != epoch || seq == 0 || seq > uint64(len(s.Seats[i].Receipts)) {
		return survival.Receipt{}, survival.ErrRule
	}
	return s.Seats[i].Receipts[seq-1], nil
}

// 入场费与局内身份原子提交；Joined 为固定 RaidID / PlayerID 的永久准入事实。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerSurvivalEnter(p ISurvivalPlayerEntity, m ISurvivalRaidEntity, now int64) error {
	s, e := survival.Decode(m.Dao().GetState())
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if !p.Dao().GetInitialized() {
		return survival.ErrRule
	}
	changed, e := s.Enter(p.ID(), now)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if !changed {
		return nil
	}
	cost := int64(s.Rules.EntryCost)
	if p.Dao().GetGold() < cost {
		return survival.ErrRule
	}
	p.Dao().SetGold(p.Dao().GetGold() - cost)
	return saveSurvival(m, s)
}

// Player 静态归属。本地同库 MultiSync 将封存清单兑付与 Claimed 原子提交；跨 sid 另接 Remote/Saga。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerSurvivalClaim(p ISurvivalPlayerEntity, m ISurvivalRaidEntity) (int64, error) {
	s, e := survival.Decode(m.Dao().GetState())
	if e != nil {
		return 0, e
	}
	i := s.Index(p.ID())
	if i < 0 || !p.Dao().GetInitialized() || !s.Seats[i].Joined || (s.Seats[i].Status != "extracted" && s.Seats[i].Status != "dead") {
		return 0, survival.ErrRule
	}
	reward := s.Reward(i)
	if s.Seats[i].Claimed {
		return reward, nil
	}
	if p.Dao().GetGold() > 1000000-reward {
		return 0, survival.ErrRule
	}
	p.Dao().SetGold(p.Dao().GetGold() + reward)
	s.Seats[i].Claimed = true
	m.Dao().SetState(s.Encode())
	return reward, nil
}
func saveSurvival(m ISurvivalRaidEntity, s survival.State) error {
	if id := m.Dao().GetWakeTimer(); id != 0 {
		m.TimerComp().RemoveTimer(id)
	}
	m.Dao().SetWakeTimer(0)
	m.Dao().SetState(s.Encode())
	if s.Deadline > 0 {
		id := m.TimerComp().NewTimerAt(time.UnixMilli(s.Deadline), matchentity.TimerPhase, s.Deadline, 0, nil)
		if id == 0 {
			return survival.ErrRule
		}
		m.Dao().SetWakeTimer(id)
	}
	return nil
}
